state_definitions.official-recipe: The essential call sequence appears in a first-party tutorial, manual, or tagged source.
state_definitions.official-api-composition: Every call is documented by first-party API/manual sources, but the exact composed workflow is a local recipe.
state_definitions.feature-only: The feature is documented, but this catalog does not claim a complete safe runnable recipe.

recipes.title: Run a setup file from a Python submission script
inputs: trusted tab-separated energetics input referenced by input_file
units_and_semantics: formation_energy is a common-reference electronic/relative formation-energy contribution, normally in eV
frequencies default to cm^-1 and are multiplied by frequency_unit_conversion to obtain eV
temperature, gas pressure convention, site basis, and rate normalization must be recorded explicitly
scientific_checks: solver branch and multiple initial guesses
failure_modes: setup files are executed as Python and are unsafe when untrusted
missing input columns or unmatched names
stiff rootfinding or unsolved map points

recipes.title: Open a trusted .mkm model in the CatMAP CLI shell
calls: model.run()  # only after reviewing the setup and inputs
outputs: normal CatMAP outputs if model.run() is invoked
units_and_semantics: same setup/input semantics as recipe.run-mkm-model
scientific_checks: inspect model.rxn_expressions, descriptor_names, temperature, gas_pressures, solver settings
failure_modes: CLI loads the .mkm file and therefore executes it
interactive changes are easy to omit from provenance

recipes.title: Render a trusted model reaction graph
outputs: Graphviz reaction-mechanism graph files named from the setup-file stem
units_and_semantics: topology visualization contains no rate, free-energy, or convergence evidence by itself
scientific_checks: compare every displayed edge/species to rxn_expressions
do not infer dominant pathway from graph layout

recipes.title: Evaluate one descriptor-space point
outputs: single-point rates, coverages, and requested solver outputs on the model
units_and_semantics: descriptor order follows descriptor_names
descriptor units follow model construction and are not encoded by the list itself

recipes.title: Plot rate and coverage descriptor maps
inputs: solved ReactionModel with rate and coverage outputs
units_and_semantics: rate vector ordering is model.output_labels['rate']
coverage vector ordering is model.output_labels['coverage']
log plots require an explicit threshold/minimum and sign policy
failure_modes: smooth interpolation conceals failed grid points
plot is mistaken for predictive validation

recipes.title: Request and plot gas production rates
inputs: trusted model and solved/solvable descriptor grid
units_and_semantics: gas ordering comes from model.output_labels['production_rate']
production, consumption, and turnover_frequency have different sign/selection semantics
failure_modes: production rate confused with one elementary-step rate

recipes.title: Compute and plot degree-of-rate-control output
inputs: declared output species and perturbation interpretation
units_and_semantics: documented definition is d log(r_i) / d(-G_j/kT)
matrix rows/columns require output_labels mapping
scientific_checks: base and perturbed states converge to the intended branch
failure_modes: local sensitivity called a unique rate-determining step

recipes.title: Build a mechanism free-energy diagram
units_and_semantics: free energies inherit the model common reference and thermochemical condition
reaction-state ordering and transition-state inclusion must be explicit
scientific_checks: same reference and condition for all states
failure_modes: chosen path presented as uniquely identified mechanism

recipes.title: Reload a trusted CatMAP log/pickle pair for analysis
units_and_semantics: map rows are [descriptor_point, output_vector]
vector labels come from output_labels
scientific_checks: do not silently re-parse changed inputs
failure_modes: both .log and pickle are executable/deserializing trust boundaries

recipes.title: Map kinetics over temperature, pressure, or potential descriptors
units_and_semantics: temperature is K
pressure convention and standard state must be captured from model settings
voltage reference must be named for electrochemical descriptors
failure_modes: using a frozen energy model outside its valid range

recipes.title: Configure first-order adsorbate interactions
inputs: coverage-dependent energetics or explicit interaction parameters
units_and_semantics: interaction parameters share the model energy unit
coverage/site definitions and response-function convention are model inputs
failure_modes: official manual explicitly warns of limited testing and backward-incompatible changes

recipes.title: Configure an electrochemical microkinetic model
outputs: potential-corrected free energies and kinetic outputs
units_and_semantics: voltage must be labeled vs RHE or SHE consistent with pe/ele convention
barrier/prefactor convention and beta are step-specific scientific assumptions
